title: Personal purpose

seo.title: Personal purpose in the destiny matrix — arcanum and meaning
seo.description: The first level of the purpose zone in the destiny matrix: what to do for yourself, signs that the level is still open, and how to close it.
queries: personal purpose in the destiny matrix
personal purpose by date of birth

meaning: Personal purpose in the destiny matrix is the first point of the purpose zone and the closest one to the person: the task they come here to carry out not for the family, not for society and not for the world, but for themselves. It is about who they have to become, which qualities to grow and what to give up inside. Nobody hands out rewards from the outside for this — and that is the main difficulty of the position.

The purpose zone in the chart is built in levels, from the particular to the general, and the personal level stands right at the start of it — it is the foundation. Its sense is that a person first puts their own life and character in order, and only after that can their energy really work for others. The point is responsible for inner support: for whether a person lives their own life or somebody else’s.

This position shows which way a person has to grow personally: which lessons they came to go through themselves, what to stop tolerating, where to stop pleasing others. It affects the sense of self, the ability to choose in your own favour without guilt, and whether a person feels they are in the right place.

When the point works, a person is busy with their own development without an eye on approval, calmly spends time and strength on what matters to them and does not wait for it to be appreciated. When it is weak, life is built around other people’s expectations: plenty of help given, plenty of praise received, and emptiness inside with no clue where your own part is. While the personal level stays unclosed, the next levels of purpose do not switch on at full strength.
